headline: South Korea Reports 1.0% Real GDP Growth in Third Quarter
summary: South Korea's real gross domestic product increased by 1.0% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the previous quarter, and grew 3.4% year-on-year.
why: Quarterly GDP data from major Asian export economies offer vital indicators of regional and global economic momentum.

impacts.name: South Korean Won
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected GDP growth can support local currency valuations.

why_moved: Better economic growth data can trigger reassessments of domestic monetary policy and currency demand.
